sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 跨度3、5、7m，各跨均布载分别8、10、12kN/m；完整属性按公共契约随题给出。 支座坐标为0/3/8/15m，按第一到第三跨配载，不按长度排序重排。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 跨度列表与荷载列表一一对应
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 四支反力、三跨中位移及中支座弯矩，附逐跨载荷表。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 跨度列表与荷载列表一一对应；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 基础工具；完整题面、参数/单位契约与真值待验证
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 左铰其余三支座竖向滚支
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 各跨不同均布竖载，按跨序对应
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 保留题定几何、材料截面、边界和荷载；采用一阶线弹性静力、自重关闭。按明示全局/局部轴、字段单位及工况/组合计算；不新增刚性楼板、未声明刚臂或规范默认组合；结果位置/分量与原题一致。 荷载与观测位置可合理分段，但不改变支承/连续条件；跨内响应须含荷载项。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 拟要求真实 OpenSees 求解，保存输入与原始结果的对应关系；解析式/独立矩阵解用于校核，不能替代规定引擎执行证据。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 拟保存（尚未生成）：OpenSees 版本、可运行模型/脚本、节点构件和荷载表、实际计算日志、原始结果与工况索引、平衡/独立解校核记录。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 逐题核验跨度列表与荷载列表一一对应；输入、结果分量/位置及数值标答尚未完成验收。 当前无据认定接口不支持；需实际能力测试后确定，不将未验证能力记为模型失败。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 拟建立独立审定的 OpenSees 模型及同版本/同设置参考结果；独立连续梁刚度法；逐跨合力/力矩和全梁平衡复核。 参考值尚未生成。 所有题定输出均须覆盖，校核实现不复用被测转换链路。

turns.instruction:
Analyze a continuous three-span beam with spans 3, 5 and 7 m in that order. Supports are at x=0, 3, 8 and 15 m: a left pin and three vertical rollers. Apply downward line loads of 8, 10 and 12 kN/m respectively to the first, second and third spans. Report all four support reactions, the three midpoint Z displacements, the two interior-support bending moments, and a span-by-span load table preserving the given order.

Use the complete attached input tables. Global XYZ is right handed with Z upward; any planar model uses the XZ plane. All nodes listed are connected physical joints. Member local x points from i to j. In 2D local y=global +Y and local z=x cross y. In 3D local y=normalize(reference cross x), local z=x cross y; reference vectors are explicit. N is positive in tension. Signed section N/T/M2/M3 equal minus the i-end resisting action at the start and plus the j-end action at the end; V2/V3 use plus i-end and minus j-end action. Report global nodal displacements and support reactions; rotations follow the right-hand rule. Distributed loads act per actual member length, including inclined members. Use first-order linear elasticity with self-weight, rigid floors, rigid offsets, P-delta and construction stages off. Use only the specified cases and combinations. Compute every request in output-requests.json, retaining its location, side, signed component, unit and case/combination. Interior forces must include applied-load terms. Execute OpenSees and retain version, runnable input, current-model hash, run ID, actual solver log and raw result/case mapping. Report the requested results in the response body as well as structured results; independently check equilibrium. No numerical answer or native execution evidence is supplied.

requiredOutputs.description: Provide a span-by-span table with span index, endpoints, length and signed downward line load.
